The real application is built, verified, and ready for your review at **http://maker:4000**

It starts empty, exactly as a brand-new setup would, so you can build it up yourself. Everything we agreed on is in place: paste a link to auto-fill its details and add tags/a note; search and tag-filter to find things; the **Read later** and **Archive** tabs; duplicate protection that sends you to edit the existing bookmark; and an **Edit** option on every entry.

**Verification report — in plain terms:**

- I checked every behaviour we approved together, end-to-end through the actual app screens — all **7 usage flows pass**:
  1. Quick-save with details filled in, tags and a note ✓
  2. Finding by search (across title, note, link and tags) and by tag ✓
  3. The reversible Read later list ✓
  4. Archiving out of the way, still searchable and restorable ✓
  5. Welcoming empty screens and a clear "nothing matches" message ✓
  6. Still being able to save when details can't be fetched, and invalid links refused ✓
  7. Duplicate warning that guides you to edit the existing bookmark ✓
- I also ran a set of internal checks on the underlying logic (**23 checks**) — all pass.

Two honest notes: the automatic detail-fetching in the live app reads real websites, so the exact title/description depends on the site (during testing I used a controlled stand-in so results were predictable); and the phone-layout *polish* you mentioned is noted for a future round, though the layout is already responsive.

Please try it out. **Do you accept this software as meeting the behaviour we approved, and agree to complete this cycle?** If anything doesn't behave as we agreed, tell me and I'll correct it within this cycle.
